definitions.name: Ranger
definitions.summary: Wilderness warrior and half caster using Wisdom. Tasha's optional features (Favored Foe, Deft Explorer, Primal Awareness and more) replace their Player's Handbook versions; switch them off on the sheet to play the PHB ranger.

definitions.name: Spellcasting Focus
definitions.summary: You can use a druidic focus as the spellcasting focus for your ranger spells.

definitions.name: Martial Versatility
definitions.summary: Whenever you gain an Ability Score Improvement from this class, you may swap your fighting style for another one the ranger can take.

definitions.name: Deft Explorer: Roving
definitions.summary: Your walking speed rises by 5 feet, and you gain climbing and swimming speeds equal to your walking speed.

definitions.name: Deft Explorer: Tireless
definitions.summary: Action: gain 1d8 + Wisdom modifier temporary hit points (at least 1), proficiency bonus times per long rest. A short rest also removes one level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Tireless
actions.note: Gain 1d8 + Wisdom modifier temporary hit points (at least 1).

definitions.name: Nature's Veil
definitions.summary: Bonus action: you become invisible until the end of your next turn. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

actions.name: Nature's Veil
actions.note: You're invisible until the end of your next turn.

definitions.name: Druidic Warrior
definitions.summary: Fighting style: learn two druid cantrips; they count as ranger spells (Wisdom). You can swap one when you gain a ranger level.

definitions.name: Ranger's Companion
definitions.summary: A beast of Medium size or smaller with a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower is your companion. It adds your proficiency bonus to its AC, attack rolls, damage rolls and the saves and skills it's proficient in, and its hit point maximum is its normal one or four times your ranger level, whichever is higher. It acts on your turn; it moves on its own, but attacks or takes another action only when you use your action to command it. If it dies, you can bond with another beast over 8 hours.

actions.name: Command companion
actions.note: Your beast takes the Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help action. From 5th level you can still attack once yourself when you command it to attack.

definitions.name: Exceptional Training
definitions.summary: When your companion doesn't attack on your turn, your bonus action can command it to Dash, Disengage or Help. Its attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance.

definitions.name: Bestial Fury
definitions.summary: Your companion can make two attacks when you command it to attack (Ranger's Companion), or when it takes the Attack action (Primal Companion).

actionNotes.text: when you command your beast to attack, it makes two attacks.

definitions.name: Share Spells
definitions.summary: A spell you cast that targets only you can also target your companion if it's within 30 feet of you.

definitions.name: Favored Foe
definitions.summary: On a hit, mark the target for 1 minute (concentration). Once per turn, the first hit on it deals extra damage (1d4, rising at 6th and 14th level).

actions.name: Favored Foe
actions.note: When you hit: mark the target for 1 minute (concentration). Once per turn, your first hit on it adds the Favored Foe die.

when.text: first hit on the marked target this turn

definitions.name: Deft Explorer: Canny
definitions.summary: Expertise in one skill you are proficient in, and two extra languages.

definitions.name: Fighting Style
definitions.summary: Pick one fighting style. Blind Fighting, Druidic Warrior and Thrown Weapon Fighting are Tasha's options.

definitions.name: Archery
definitions.summary: +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

definitions.name: Primal Awareness
definitions.summary: Extra spells as you gain ranger levels: Speak with Animals (3rd), Beast Sense (5th), Speak with Plants (9th), Locate Creature (13th), Commune with Nature (17th). They're always known, don't count against your spells known, and each can be cast once per long rest without a slot.

spells.name: Speak with Animals
spells.casting: Free once per long rest, or with a ranger slot

spells.name: Beast Sense
spells.casting: Free once per long rest, or with a ranger slot

spells.name: Speak with Plants
spells.casting: Free once per long rest, or with a ranger slot

spells.name: Locate Creature
spells.casting: Free once per long rest, or with a ranger slot

spells.name: Commune with Nature
spells.casting: Free once per long rest, or with a ranger slot

actions.name: Speak with Animals (free)
actions.note: Cast without a slot, once per long rest.

definitions.name: Beast Master
definitions.summary: A beast companion fights alongside the ranger: the Player's Handbook's Ranger's Companion, or Tasha's Primal Companion in its place.

definitions.name: Primal Companion
definitions.summary: Summon a Beast of the Land, Sea or Sky that scales with proficiency bonus. It Dodges unless commanded with a bonus action, or in place of one of your attacks.

actions.name: Command companion
actions.note: Your beast acts on your turn; otherwise it takes the Dodge action. It can also attack in place of one of your attacks.

companions.name: Primal beast
companions.combatNote: Acts on your turn. It takes the Dodge action unless you spend a bonus action to command it, or give up one of your attacks to have it attack. If you're incapacitated it acts on its own.

revive.note: Within an hour of its death, touch it as an action and spend a spell slot: it returns after 1 minute with all its hit points.

traits.name: Primal Bond
traits.summary: Adds your proficiency bonus to its ability checks and saving throws (included in its numbers here).

traits.name: Charge
traits.summary: If it moves at least 20 ft straight toward a target and then hits with its maul on the same turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 slashing damage and, if a creature, must succeed on a Strength save against your spell save DC or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Multiattack (Bestial Fury)
traits.summary: When it takes the Attack action, it makes two attacks.

traits.name: Primal Bond
traits.summary: Adds your proficiency bonus to its ability checks and saving throws (included in its numbers here).

attacks.name: Binding Strike
attacks.note: Piercing or bludgeoning (your choice). On a hit the target is grappled (escape DC = your spell save DC); while grappling, the beast can't use this attack on another target.

traits.name: Multiattack (Bestial Fury)
traits.summary: When it takes the Attack action, it makes two attacks.

traits.name: Primal Bond
traits.summary: Adds your proficiency bonus to its ability checks and saving throws (included in its numbers here).

traits.name: Flyby
traits.summary: Doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Multiattack (Bestial Fury)
traits.summary: When it takes the Attack action, it makes two attacks.

definitions.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
definitions.summary: Fighting style: when you fight with two weapons, your ability modifier is added to the damage of the off-hand attack.

definitions.name: Dragon Ancestor: Black - Acid Damage
definitions.summary: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor.
text: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.
You can speak, read, and write Draconic. Additionally, whenever you make a Charisma check when interacting with dragons, your proficiency bonus is doubled if it applies to the check.

definitions.name: Elemental Affinity
definitions.summary: Starting at 6th level, when you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.
text: Starting at 6th level, when you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell. At the same time, you can spend 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to that damage type for 1 hour.

actions.name: Elemental Affinity: resistance
actions.note: When you cast a spell of your dragon ancestor's damage type: 1 sorcery point for resistance to that type for 1 hour.
